MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #9
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x
   B. 6x
   C. 12x + 2
   D. 6x + 2

2. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 22
   C. 38
   D. 88

3. What is √64? (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 64
   C. 9
   D. 32

4. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 37

5. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 29
   B. 23.7
   C. 23.6
   D. 23

6. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

7. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. Cannot tell
   B. They are equal
   C. 1/4
   D. 2/2

8. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 43
   C. 2
   D. 1

9. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.6
   B. 19.7
   C. 25
   D. 19

10. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 23
   C. 46
   D. 120

11. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

12. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.6
   B. 15.7
   C. 15
   D. 21

13. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 9 cm³
   B. 12 cm³
   C. 27 cm³
   D. 18 cm³

14. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 31.7
   C. 31.6
   D. 37

15. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27
   B. 33
   C. 27.6
   D. 27.7

16. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 2

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
